items.title: Rudolph Beaulieu Interview, 1961-05-31
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I wonder what happened to Harold.

ctx.x: Not keeping you from your supper, are we? Huh? Not keeping you from your supper?

No, indeed. I don't. Y'all want a cold drink? I don't believe so unless you do that. Thank you very much. We just stopped on the way over and had some root beer. I wonder what happened to Harold. He must be pulling out his teeth. Oh. Oh. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.
